name: Anomaly Lockdown [UPDATE!]
desc:
Experience the ultimate round-based survival game inspired by RBreach, Minitoon's SCP Containment Breach, SCP: Secret Laboratory and many more.

Game is in a very early development stage, expect some bugs!

Game utilizes full Voice Chat Support: Communicate using Proximity Chat or use found Radios to talk to your team across the map!

Basic Controls:
Shift to sprint
E to interact with doors pick up items
Q to Open inventory
F3 to open votekick menu/mod call

Credit to ampersad for various reinforcement wave spawn music
Credit to Maximum_ADHD and The Stalker: Reborn for heavy inspiration on SCP-966
Console playability is only available to players with a mouse and keyboard.

scripts.title: simple inf stamina and ammo
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local GENV = getgenv()

if GENV.AnomalyLockdown and GENV.AnomalyLockdown.Unload then
	pcall(GENV.AnomalyLockdown.Unload)
end

local State = {
	InfiniteStamina = false,
	InfiniteAmmo = false,
	Running = true,

	Guns = {},
	GunConnections = {},
	Connections = {},
	StaminaConnections = {},

	OriginalMaxStamina = nil
}

GENV.AnomalyLockdown = State

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
	Name = "Anomaly Lockdown",
	Icon = 0,

	LoadingTitle = "Anomaly Lockdown",
	LoadingSubtitle = "Utilities",

	ShowText = "Anomaly Lockdown",

	Theme = "Default",

	ToggleUIKeybind = "K",

	DisableRayfieldPrompts = false,
	DisableBuildWarnings = false,

	ConfigurationSaving = {
		Enabled = false,
		FolderName = nil,
		FileName = "AnomalyLockdown"
	},

	Discord = {
		Enabled = false,
		Invite = "",
		RememberJoins = false
	},

	KeySystem = false
})

local Main = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)
local Extras = Window:CreateTab("Extras", 4483362458)

local function DisconnectList(List)
	for _, Connection in ipairs(List) do
		pcall(function()
			Connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end

	table.clear(List)
end

local function GetPlayerData()
	return Player:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
end

local function GetStaminaValues()
	local PlayerData = GetPlayerData()

	if not PlayerData then
		return nil, nil
	end

	return
		PlayerData:FindFirstChild("MaxStamina"),
		PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Stamina")
end

local function ForceStamina()
	if not State.InfiniteStamina then
		return
	end

	local MaxStamina, Stamina = GetStaminaValues()

	if not MaxStamina or not Stamina then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		if MaxStamina.Value ~= 999999 then
			MaxStamina.Value = 999999
		end

		if Stamina.Value ~= 999999 then
			Stamina.Value = 999999
		end
	end)
end

local function SetupStaminaWatch()
	DisconnectList(State.StaminaConnections)

	local MaxStamina, Stamina = GetStaminaValues()

	if not MaxStamina or not Stamina then
		return false
	end

	if State.OriginalMaxStamina == nil then
		State.OriginalMaxStamina = MaxStamina.Value
	end

	table.insert(
		State.StaminaConnections,
		MaxStamina:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
			if State.InfiniteStamina and MaxStamina.Value ~= 999999 then
				MaxStamina.Value = 999999
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		State.StaminaConnections,
		Stamina:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
			if State.InfiniteStamina and Stamina.Value ~= 999999 then
				Stamina.Value = 999999
			end
		end)
	)

	ForceStamina()

	return true
end

local function DisableStamina()
	DisconnectList(State.StaminaConnections)

	local MaxStamina, Stamina = GetStaminaValues()

	if MaxStamina and State.OriginalMaxStamina ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			MaxStamina.Value = State.OriginalMaxStamina
		end)
	end

	if Stamina and MaxStamina then
		pcall(function()
			if Stamina.Value > MaxStamina.Value then
				Stamina.Value = MaxStamina.Value
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function IsGunConfig(Object)
	if not Object then
		return false
	end

	if Object.Name ~= "GunConfigs" then
		return false
	end

	return Object:FindFirstChild("Ammo") ~= nil
		or Object:FindFirstChild("Clip") ~= nil
end

local function IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Object)
	if not Object then
		return false
	end

	local Backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local Character = Player.Character

	if Backpack and Object:IsDescendantOf(Backpack) then
		return true
	end

	if Character and Object:IsDescendantOf(Character) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local function FindMaxValues(Config)
	local MaxAmmo
	local MaxClip

	local AmmoConfigs = Config:FindFirstChild("AmmoConfigs")

	if AmmoConfigs then
		MaxAmmo = AmmoConfigs:FindFirstChild("MaxAmmo", true)
		MaxClip = AmmoConfigs:FindFirstChild("MaxClip", true)
	end

	return MaxAmmo, MaxClip
end

local function FillGun(Config)
	if not State.InfiniteAmmo then
		return
	end

	if not Config or not Config.Parent then
		return
	end

	if not IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config) then
		return
	end

	local Ammo = Config:FindFirstChild("Ammo")
	local Clip = Config:FindFirstChild("Clip")

	local MaxAmmo, MaxClip = FindMaxValues(Config)

	pcall(function()
		if MaxAmmo and MaxAmmo.Value ~= 999999 then
			MaxAmmo.Value = 999999
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if MaxClip and MaxClip.Value ~= 999999 then
			MaxClip.Value = 999999
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if Ammo and Ammo.Value ~= 999999 then
			Ammo.Value = 999999
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if Clip and Clip.Value ~= 999999 then
			Clip.Value = 999999
		end
	end)
end

local function RemoveGun(Config)
	State.Guns[Config] = nil

	local Connections = State.GunConnections[Config]

	if Connections then
		DisconnectList(Connections)
		State.GunConnections[Config] = nil
	end
end

local function RegisterGun(Config)
	if not IsGunConfig(Config) then
		return
	end

	if State.Guns[Config] then
		if State.InfiniteAmmo then
			FillGun(Config)
		end

		return
	end

	State.Guns[Config] = true
	State.GunConnections[Config] = {}

	local Connections = State.GunConnections[Config]

	local Ammo = Config:FindFirstChild("Ammo")
	local Clip = Config:FindFirstChild("Clip")
	local MaxAmmo, MaxClip = FindMaxValues(Config)

	local function WatchValue(ValueObject)
		if not ValueObject then
			return
		end

		table.insert(
			Connections,
			ValueObject:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
				if State.InfiniteAmmo then
					FillGun(Config)
				end
			end)
		)
	end

	WatchValue(Ammo)
	WatchValue(Clip)
	WatchValue(MaxAmmo)
	WatchValue(MaxClip)

	table.insert(
		Connections,
		Config.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			task.delay(0.15, function()
				if not State.Running then
					return
				end

				if not Config.Parent then
					RemoveGun(Config)
					return
				end

				if not IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config) then
					RemoveGun(Config)
				end
			end)
		end)
	)

	if State.InfiniteAmmo then
		FillGun(Config)
	end
end

local function RegisterTool(Tool)
	if not Tool then
		return
	end

	local Config = Tool:FindFirstChild("GunConfigs")

	if Config and IsGunConfig(Config) then
		RegisterGun(Config)
		return
	end

	for _, Object in ipairs(Tool:GetChildren()) do
		if IsGunConfig(Object) then
			RegisterGun(Object)
			return
		end
	end

	local DescendantConnection

	DescendantConnection = Tool.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(Object)
		if IsGunConfig(Object) then
			RegisterGun(Object)

			if DescendantConnection then
				DescendantConnection:Disconnect()
				DescendantConnection = nil
			end
		end
	end)

	task.delay(5, function()
		if DescendantConnection then
			DescendantConnection:Disconnect()
			DescendantConnection = nil
		end
	end)
end

local function ScanContainerOnce(Container)
	if not Container then
		return
	end

	for _, Object in ipairs(Container:GetChildren()) do
		RegisterTool(Object)
	end
end

local function ScanCurrentGuns()
	local Backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local Character = Player.Character

	ScanContainerOnce(Backpack)
	ScanContainerOnce(Character)
end

local function CountGuns()
	local Count = 0

	for Config in pairs(State.Guns) do
		if Config
			and Config.Parent
			and IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config)
		then
			Count += 1
		end
	end

	return Count
end

local function FillAllGuns()
	if not State.InfiniteAmmo then
		return
	end

	for Config in pairs(State.Guns) do
		if Config
			and Config.Parent
			and IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config)
		then
			FillGun(Config)
		end
	end
end

local function IsLoseClipRemote(Object)
	if typeof(Object) ~= "Instance" then
		return false
	end

	if Object.Name ~= "LoseClip" then
		return false
	end

	if not IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Object) then
		return false
	end

	local Current = Object.Parent

	while Current do
		if Current.Name == "ServerMain" then
			return true
		end

		Current = Current.Parent
	end

	return false
end

if type(hookmetamethod) == "function"
	and type(getnamecallmethod) == "function"
	and type(newcclosure) == "function"
then

	local OldNamecall

	OldNamecall = hookmetamethod(
		game,
		"__namecall",
		newcclosure(function(Self, ...)
			local Method = getnamecallmethod()

			if State.InfiniteAmmo
				and (
					Method == "FireServer"
					or Method == "InvokeServer"
				)
				and IsLoseClipRemote(Self)
			then
				return nil
			end

			return OldNamecall(Self, ...)
		end)
	)
end

local WatchedContainers = {}

local function WatchContainer(Container)
	if not Container then
		return
	end

	if WatchedContainers[Container] then
		return
	end

	WatchedContainers[Container] = true

	ScanContainerOnce(Container)

	local AddedConnection = Container.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Object)
		task.defer(function()
			RegisterTool(Object)
		end)
	end)

	local RemovedConnection = Container.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(Object)
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			if Object.Parent then
				return
			end

			for Config in pairs(State.Guns) do
				if Config
					and (
						Config == Object
						or Config:IsDescendantOf(Object)
					)
				then
					RemoveGun(Config)
				end
			end
		end)
	end)

	table.insert(State.Connections, AddedConnection)
	table.insert(State.Connections, RemovedConnection)
end

local function SetupPlayerWatchers()
	local Backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

	if Backpack then
		WatchContainer(Backpack)
	end

	if Player.Character then
		WatchContainer(Player.Character)
	end

	table.insert(
		State.Connections,
		Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character)
			task.wait(0.15)

			WatchContainer(Character)

			if State.InfiniteStamina then
				SetupStaminaWatch()
			end

			if State.InfiniteAmmo then
				ScanCurrentGuns()
				FillAllGuns()
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		State.Connections,
		Player.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Object)
			if Object:IsA("Backpack") then
				task.defer(function()
					WatchContainer(Object)

					if State.InfiniteAmmo then
						ScanCurrentGuns()
						FillAllGuns()
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	)
end

Main:CreateSection("Player")

Main:CreateToggle({
	Name = "Infinite Stamina",
	CurrentValue = false,
	Flag = "AnomalyInfiniteStamina",

	Callback = function(Value)
		State.InfiniteStamina = Value

		if Value then
			local Worked = SetupStaminaWatch()

			Rayfield:Notify({
				Title = "Infinite Stamina",

				Content = Worked
					and "Enabled"
					or "Stamina values not found",

				Duration = 4
			})
		else
			DisableStamina()

			Rayfield:Notify({
				Title = "Infinite Stamina",
				Content = "Disabled",
				Duration = 3
			})
		end
	end
})

Main:CreateSection("Weapons")

Main:CreateToggle({
	Name = "Infinite Ammo",
	CurrentValue = false,
	Flag = "AnomalyInfiniteAmmo",

	Callback = function(Value)
		State.InfiniteAmmo = Value

		if Value then
			ScanCurrentGuns()
			FillAllGuns()

			Rayfield:Notify({
				Title = "Infinite Ammo",

				Content =
					"Enabled | Guns: "
					.. tostring(CountGuns()),

				Duration = 4
			})
		else
			Rayfield:Notify({
				Title = "Infinite Ammo",
				Content = "Disabled",
				Duration = 3
			})
		end
	end
})

Main:CreateButton({
	Name = "Rescan My Guns",

	Callback = function()
		ScanCurrentGuns()

		if State.InfiniteAmmo then
			FillAllGuns()
		end

		Rayfield:Notify({
			Title = "Gun Scanner",

			Content =
				"Guns found: "
				.. tostring(CountGuns()),

			Duration = 4
		})
	end
})

Main:CreateButton({
	Name = "Print Detected Guns",

	Callback = function()
		ScanCurrentGuns()

		print("========== ANOMALY LOCKDOWN ==========")
		print("Player:", Player.Name)
		print("")

		for Config in pairs(State.Guns) do
			if Config
				and Config.Parent
				and IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config)
			then
				print(Config:GetFullName())

				local Ammo = Config:FindFirstChild("Ammo")
				local Clip = Config:FindFirstChild("Clip")
				local MaxAmmo, MaxClip = FindMaxValues(Config)

				if Ammo then
					print("Ammo:", Ammo.Value)
				end

				if Clip then
					print("Clip:", Clip.Value)
				end

				if MaxAmmo then
					print("MaxAmmo:", MaxAmmo.Value)
				end

				if MaxClip then
					print("MaxClip:", MaxClip.Value)
				end

				print("--------------------------------")
			end
		end

		print("TOTAL:", CountGuns())
		print("====================================")
	end
})

Extras:CreateSection("Themes")

local Themes = {
	["Default"] = "Default",
	["Dark Blue"] = "DarkBlue",
	["Amber"] = "AmberGlow",
	["Purple"] = "Amethyst",
	["Bloom"] = "Bloom",
	["Green"] = "Green",
	["Ocean"] = "Ocean",
	["Serenity"] = "Serenity",
	["Light"] = "Light"
}

Extras:CreateDropdown({
	Name = "Theme",

	Options = {
		"Default",
		"Dark Blue",
		"Amber",
		"Purple",
		"Bloom",
		"Green",
		"Ocean",
		"Serenity",
		"Light"
	},

	CurrentOption = {"Default"},
	MultipleOptions = false,

	Callback = function(Option)
		local Selected =
			type(Option) == "table"
			and Option[1]
			or Option

		if Selected and Themes[Selected] then
			pcall(function()
				Window.ModifyTheme(
					Themes[Selected]
				)
			end)
		end
	end
})

Extras:CreateSection("UI")

Extras:CreateKeybind({
	Name = "Hide / Show UI",
	CurrentKeybind = "K",
	HoldToInteract = false,

	Callback = function()
		pcall(function()
			Rayfield:Toggle()
		end)
	end
})

SetupPlayerWatchers()
ScanCurrentGuns()

State.Unload = function()
	State.Running = false
	State.InfiniteAmmo = false
	State.InfiniteStamina = false

	DisconnectList(State.StaminaConnections)

	for Config in pairs(State.Guns) do
		RemoveGun(Config)
	end

	DisconnectList(State.Connections)

	table.clear(State.Guns)
	table.clear(State.GunConnections)

	pcall(function()
		Rayfield:Destroy()
	end)
end

Rayfield:Notify({
	Title = "Anomaly Lockdown",

	Content =
		"Loaded | "
		.. Player.Name,

	Duration = 5
})

scripts.title: very simple inf stamina
scripts.script:
-- Powered by ScriptBlox.com

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local playerData = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerData", 5)

if playerData then
    local stamina = playerData:FindFirstChild("Stamina")
    local maxStamina = playerData:FindFirstChild("MaxStamina")

    if stamina then
        stamina.Value = 99999999
    end

    if maxStamina then
        maxStamina.Value = 99999999
    end
end
